If they're set up on your computer, T3 Code can control them. ## "Wait, what are you selling me?" Nothing. We built T3 Code because we wanted the best possible development experience with agents. We were inspired by existing solutions like the Codex desktop app, Conductor, Claude Desktop and Cursor Glass, but none met our bar. We wanted something performant, remote-ready, and truly open. If we ever go the wrong direction, we want you to have everything you need to fork and build the editor that you want. ## Installation > [!WARNING] > T3 Code currently supports Codex, Claude, Cursor, Grok Build, OpenCode, Antigravity, and fx. Debian patched it on October 16 . Ubuntu still doesn't have a patch more than two weeks later. Every supported release, LTS included, is listed as "Vulnerable". Ubuntu's website promises "timely patches for critical vulnerabilities." Ubuntu hasn't shipped the patch nine days after it was rated 9.8 and six days after a working root exploit. Very fucking timely indeed. Software is full of this blabber where words mean nothing. Ubuntu uses words like these: "Timely." "Enterprise-grade." "Production grade." "Enterprise resilience. Developer velocity. Build with confidence on Ubuntu." Somebody, or perhaps worse, some special team at Canonical is dedicated to writing these........ So I'm asking again... What the fuck, Ubuntu? L Ubuntu has not shipped fixed kernels for CVE-2026-98432 , a critical vulnerability scored CVSS 9.8, leaving the 22.04, 24.04, and 26.04 LTS releases without a vendor update. Operators running those releases therefore have no official kernel package that closes the hole. The gap matters most for internet-facing and multi-tenant self-hosted systems that rely on Ubuntu’s LTS kernels for isolation and privilege boundaries; until packages appear, those hosts remain exposed to whatever remote or local attack the CVE enables. Ubuntu has not announced an ETA for the fixes. In the interim, affected administrators are left to decide whether to stay on the stock kernel, apply out-of-tree mitigations if any exist, or move workloads onto releases or kernels that already carry the patch. #ubuntu #linux #kernel

hn_items.author: cdrnsf

【文章原文节选】: Anthropic’s growth just flattened (really) Subscribe Sign in Anthropic’s growth just flattened (really) Look at the monthly numbers... Henry Blodget Oct 15, 2026 37 4 Share Source: Regenerator estimates and news reports. Anthropic shared high-level Q3 financials with investors yesterday, report the NYT’s Andrew Ross Sorkin , Lauren Hirsch , and Sri Muppidi . Revenue for Q3 was reportedly $16.8 billion. At first glance, this number seems astonishing. And, in one sense, it is. It’s another jaw-dropping sequential gain for what is likely the fastest-growing company in history. But, break the trend down into implied monthly growth, and the picture looks different. Specifically, it seems Anthropic barely grew from July to September. Anthropic’s sequential revenue growth in Q3, moreover, was smaller in absolute dollars than its (gobsmacking) growth in Q2. So, for several possible reasons, Anthropic’s growth has meaningfully slowed. This is likely another reason why the stocks of “neocloud” providers like CoreWeave are collapsing.
